name: hms-enterprise
description: Enterprise Hospital Management System (Arabic-first, RTL, PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:reset && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm -w apps/web run build && npm -w apps/api run dev
scripts.build: npm -w apps/web run build && npm -w apps/api run build
scripts.build:vercel: npm -w apps/web run build && node scripts/vercel-build.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm -w apps/api run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
